Below are instructions for the no-crash bug detection task.

### [Task Description]
You are given a tested function sequence from a mobile app.
Please analyze the GUI sequence and determine whether the page transitions and interaction results meet the expected behavior of the tested function.
You should detect non-crash functional bugs, identify possible bug-triggering paths, and point out abnormal or exception paths.

### [Bug examples]
The categories of bugs include:
Page loading failure
Widget occlusion/overlap
Content missing
Feedback missing
Data operation failure
Media control not responding
Numerical calculation errors
Setting & configuration failures
Navigation & linking errors

We provide the bug examples:
(1) {'bug_id': 'ex_001', 'app_name': 'Amethyst', 'function_name': 'Copy note text from media view', 'bug_type': 'clipboard content error', 'bug_category': 'Content missing', 'bug_description': 'Copy Text in media view copies empty content instead of the note text containing the media URL.', 'bug_replay_path': ['Go to media view', 'Open the three-dot menu', 'Tap Copy Text', 'Try paste at any text input view like Search Bar'], 'expected_behavior': 'The note text including the media URL should be copied to the clipboard.', 'actual_behavior': 'Empty content is copied to the clipboard.'}
(2) {'bug_id': 'ex_002', 'app_name': 'Unknown', 'function_name': 'Create and save a password entry', 'bug_type': 'UI state not updated', 'bug_category': 'Content missing', 'bug_description': "After saving a new password entry, the header title remains '(no title)' instead of updating to the saved title.", 'bug_replay_path': ["Tap the '+' button", 'Enter a title', 'Tap the save icon', 'Remain on the password entry page'], 'expected_behavior': 'The header title should update to the title of the saved password entry.', 'actual_behavior': "The save icon disappears but the header still shows '(no title)'."}
(3) {'bug_id': 'ex_003', 'app_name': 'floccus', 'function_name': 'Open settings page', 'bug_type': 'button has no response', 'bug_category': 'Feedback missing', 'bug_description': 'Pressing the settings button does nothing and the settings page does not open.', 'bug_replay_path': ['Open floccus Android app', 'Tap the settings button in the upper right corner'], 'expected_behavior': 'The settings page should open.', 'actual_behavior': 'Nothing happens after pressing the settings button.'}
(4) {'bug_id': 'ex_004', 'app_name': 'Blockstream Green', 'function_name': 'Log into wallet when offline', 'bug_type': 'misleading error message', 'bug_category': 'Navigation & linking errors', 'bug_description': "When the device is offline, the app shows a 'PIN error' instead of a network error.", 'bug_replay_path': ['Create a wallet and set a PIN while connected to the internet', 'Disconnect from the internet', 'Close the app', 'Open the app again', 'Try to log into the wallet'], 'expected_behavior': "The app should show a network-related error such as 'Unable to connect'.", 'actual_behavior': "The app shows 'PIN error'."}
(5) {'bug_id': 'ex_005', 'app_name': 'Amethyst', 'function_name': 'Copy text from edited post', 'bug_type': 'stale clipboard data', 'bug_category': 'Navigation & linking errors', 'bug_description': 'Copying text from an edited post copies the original text instead of the updated text.', 'bug_replay_path': ['Create a new post', 'Edit the post and change the text', 'Use Copy Text'], 'expected_behavior': 'The copied text should be the updated edited content.', 'actual_behavior': 'The original text before editing is copied.'}
(6) {'bug_id': 'ex_006', 'app_name': 'Simplenote', 'function_name': 'Use Notes List widget after logout', 'bug_type': 'wrong navigation after logout', 'bug_category': 'Navigation & linking errors', 'bug_description': 'After logging out, tapping the Notes List widget opens a new note instead of redirecting to the login screen.', 'bug_replay_path': ['Log in to the app', 'Add the Notes List widget to the home screen', 'Confirm the widget works normally', 'Log out of the app', 'Tap the widget on the home screen'], 'expected_behavior': "The widget should show 'Log in to use widget' and open the login screen when tapped.", 'actual_behavior': 'A new note is opened and the widget becomes blank.'}
